pages.text: The Substitute Puppet stacks to one. Use it in air once to register its owner. Its tooltip shows owner, respawn anchor and durability.
Hold the puppet in one hand and Nurturing Crystal in the other, then use it. Eight crystals restore one durability, consuming as many complete groups as possible up to sixteen.
When its owner dies, a puppet in inventory, Kongqiao or Xianqiao storage triggers a cooldown-free Totem effect and spends one durability. The activation animation displays the puppet.

Use the puppet on a Respawn Anchor to bind it. A later activation teleports the owner there across dimensions without cheat permission. Use the puppet in air to clear the anchor; breaking or exploding the bound anchor also clears it automatically.
